name: card-together
description: Multiplayer card games to play together

scripts.dev:server: cd server && npx tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build:client: npm run music:import && npm run emoji:import && cd client && npx tsc -b && npx vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client
scripts.typecheck:server: cd server && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:client: cd client && npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
